title: PSG-24A Deterministic Surface Feature Fields
visual_intent: A closed curved plaster proof object shows discrete fine speckles, dried droplets, and sparse mud drops over a clean plaster base, with ambient fill making the convex ridge, concave trough, and opposing fold readable.
expected_visual_signal: The beauty views must show bounded circular or elliptical deposits rather than a broad tint. Coverage, interior, and rim views must directly visualize the native PSG-24 feature channels and remain spatially aligned with the beauty deposits.
rejection_condition: Reject if ambient fill is absent, the object shape is unreadable, feature channels are confused with the older PSG-19 carrier, repeat pixels differ, or the deposits collapse into a broad color wash.
